# rsBreakWall2D · Break a 2D wall

> Module: 2D Architecture / Grids & Walls

[← Back to command index](/en/commands/)

**Function**: Break the 2D wall at the specified location

**Run**: Enter `rsBreakWall2D` in the Rhino command line (command-line interaction).

**Workflow**:

1. Select a 2D wall to interrupt
2. Specify break points on the wall
3. The wall was broken into two sections

**Parameters**:

> This command has no numeric command-line parameters. Adjust its options in the settings window.

**Notes**: What needs to be interrupted is the smart 2D wall generated by rsWall2D.
